## History

Mirabel Cotton was a student taught by [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) after [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returned to her teaching duties. During her time in the schoolroom, Mirabel was involved in minor classroom incidents alongside fellow students [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) and [Dora](../character/dora.md).

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P1](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0001), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P3](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0003), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P4](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0004), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P6](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0006), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P11](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0011), +32 more_
